Practised storing drinking water safely.
Discussed clean, covered containers and using a ladle or tap.
Discussed regular cleaning of the matka and keeping it in a suitable place.
The cold-water explanation was corrected to focus on preventing dust, germs and mosquitoes.
Teach-back was not passed; unaided responses were correct in 3 of 5 attempts.
end.parentNote: Pari practised explaining why drinking water should be kept in a clean, covered matka and taken out with a ladle rather than a hand. They described regular cleaning and identified that an open container can let in dust, germs and mosquitoes. Pari first focused on keeping water cold, then corrected this later by explaining that covering prevents contamination. At home, ask Pari to explain the storage steps using a real covered container and ladle.
